messages.text:
OPT-SoftEng-03 patch is ready. Changed only `compact.py` and `test_compact.py`, after the source freeze was released.

Per-disc collectors now follow their signed disc displacement, preserving the ±36.7 mm local offset. Added discs receive all three donor2 collector wedges. Rails retain their original four-wall cross sections and fixed |z|=611…3134 mm extent; their 6.3 mm slots follow every candidate disc.

For the coverage candidate, each end gains 4,155,214.9569 mm³ of donor collector material and loses 229.824 mm³ of CFRP for the added rail slot. Material references and densities remain unchanged; these inventory changes are recorded in the compact audit.

Portable tests: **7/7 passed**; diff check passed. All 20 complete disc subtrees—including sensitive elements and local supports—match the previous coverage compact exactly.

Trunk, bypass and rear cells remain frozen reference inventory. Updated routing, connectivity and capacity are explicitly unqualified. I launched no native checks; the coordinator-owned corrected overlap audit remains required before claiming physical clearance.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
